description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield as a Forest land creature due to Ashaya, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
